root_cause: FYERS adapter and FYERS read-only adapter independently converted expiry timestamps, creating string-versus-integer drift.
correction: Added tfis.broker.timestamp_normalization for deterministic provider timestamp normalization.
FYERS option-chain request timestamps now use integer epoch seconds.
FYERS read-only option-chain request timestamps now use the same integer epoch representation.
Raw provider timestamp values are preserved in NormalizedProviderTimestamp.to_dict().
